_: 도구 설명에 덧붙인 계약 문장 — 되뜰 수 없는 채록본(m1-tools.json)을 손대지 않고, 대조 직전에 이 표대로 조립해 문다.
_why: 여기 실린 셋은 없는 대상에 성공 모양으로 답한다(실측: GetPackageContents -> [], ReadPackage -> success:true·metadata:null, GetInactiveObjects -> 0건). 채록본의 설명은 그 사실을 말하지 않아 사람과 모델이 빈 결과를 '없음이 확인됐다'로 읽어 왔다. 절차 문서 세 곳이 이미 믿지 말라고 적는데도 재발했다 — 계약 불일치는 계약이 있는 자리에서만 닫힌다.
_shape: 값은 설명 전문이 아니라 꼬리에 붙는 덧말이다. 소비자는 `채록본 원문 + 덧말`을 조립해 글자 일치를 요구하므로, 원문이 한 글자라도 움직이면 대조는 그대로 실패한다. 전문을 적었다면 무엇이든 통과했을 것이다.
_consumers: gates/surface.mjs (ⓐ 선언 대조) · src/tools/read/__tests__/support.ts (publishedDeclaration). 판S5의 SAP 자산 개명(RENAMED_SAP_ASSETS)은 시험 소비자가 없어 게이트에만 남아 있다 — 성질은 같고 자리만 다르다.
_added: 판A1 · 2026-09-03 · D-145 — descriptions 3건. 2026-09-09 · D-147(E1 쓰기 경로): descriptions 2건(ActivateObjects · UpdateSourceByPatch) + inputSchemaProperties 신설(UpdateSourceByPatch.match_whole_line)
_inputSchemaProperties: 채록본에 없던 **선택 인자**를 덧붙이는 표. 값은 발행되는 JSON Schema의 property 그대로이고, 소비자는 채록본 `inputSchema.properties`에 이것을 얹어 대조한다. 필수 인자는 여기로 더할 수 없다(`required`는 손대지 않는다) — 기존 호출이 깨지는 변경은 덧말이 아니라 계약 파기다.

descriptions.GetPackageContents: A package that does not exist returns an empty list, which is indistinguishable from a package that exists and is empty — this tool cannot establish absence. Confirm existence with GetPackage (HTTP 400 when missing) or SearchObject (0 hits) before reading an empty result as "nothing is there". Returns object names and types only, never source.
descriptions.ReadPackage: A package that does not exist still answers success: true with metadata: null — null metadata means the package is absent, not that it exists without attributes. GetPackage returns HTTP 400 for the same missing package; prefer it when the question is whether the package exists at all.
descriptions.GetInactiveObjects: Takes no arguments and reports the whole system, so an empty result means "nothing anywhere is inactive" — which is also what a system returns for an object that was never created. An empty result is therefore not evidence that a particular object activated; read that object back to confirm.
descriptions.ActivateObjects: When the run reports activationExecuted=false and checkExecuted=false, nothing was activated regardless of the per-object entries: success is false, run_executed is false and every object carries status 'not_executed' (REPOSRC.R3STATE stays 'I' even though GetInactiveObjects may not list the object). Do not retry such a run — rewrite the full source with UpdateInclude (main_program set) or UpdateClass, activate:true, which has cleared this state in practice.
descriptions.UpdateSourceByPatch: Reads the inactive version first and falls back to the active one (source_version_read in the response says which), so consecutive activate:false patches no longer overwrite each other. Line endings are normalized for matching (multi-line old_string works on CRLF sources) and the source's own line ending is restored on write. A non-unique old_string is rejected with the line number and text of every match; set match_whole_line to require whole-line matches. Function-group includes (L<group>TOP, L<group>F01, ...) are written through the function-group include address.

match_whole_line.description: Require every line of old_string to match a whole source line (leading/trailing whitespace ignored) instead of a substring match. Use it when a short anchor is also part of another statement (FORM x. inside PERFORM x.) or differs only by indentation. Default: false.
